item.title: k8s: Kubernetes v1.37: Storage Version Migration Enabled by Default
item.description:
Kubernetes v1.37 makes built-in StorageVersionMigration (storagemigration.k8s.io/v1) GA and enabled by default in all clusters. It lets administrators and CRD authors declaratively rewrite stored objects to the current storage version, replacing manual re-write scripts or the out-of-tree migrator.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Workload identity support for Azure Files CSI driver (SMB) in Azure
item.description:
Azure Files CSI driver for AKS now supports workload identity for pod-level authentication to SMB file shares. This adds an alternative to managed identity for accessing Azure Files from pods.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: k8s: Kubernetes v1.37: Garhwal
item.description:
Kubernetes v1.37 ships 67 enhancements: 16 Stable, 23 Beta, 27 Alpha, and 1 deprecation/removal. Key changes include resilient watchcache initialization, HPA scale-to-zero, manifest-based admission config, Pod checkpoint/restore, broader Dynamic Resource Allocation support, and multiple scheduler, storage, node, and observability updates.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Live Resize for Shared Premium SSD v2 and Ultra Data Disks
item.description:
Live Resize is now generally available for shared Premium SSD v2 and Ultra data disks. It lets you expand disk capacity dynamically without application disruption.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: k8s: Kubernetes v1.37 Sneak Peek
item.description:
Kubernetes v1.37 is planning several deprecations and a few feature graduations. Notable changes include deprecating kubectl run -f, forbidding Static Pods from referencing Secrets/ConfigMaps, starting deprecation of kube-proxy ipvs mode, and moving SELinuxMount to GA with possible workload impact.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Support for SMB Opportunistic Locking (Oplocks) configuration
item.description:
Azure NetApp Files public preview adds configurable SMB opportunistic locking (oplocks) for SMB and dual-protocol volumes. Oplocks remain enabled by default and can be set on new volumes or updated on existing ones.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Databricks natively storing data in Microsoft OneLake
item.description:
Azure Databricks now supports natively writing managed Delta tables to Microsoft OneLake in public preview. This lets customers use OneLake as the storage layer for Databricks workloads without managing separate storage accounts.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: k8s: Spotlight on SIG Storage
item.description:
SIG Storage discusses its role in Kubernetes persistent storage, including CSI/COSI, data protection, and emerging work for AI workloads. Recent updates include VolumeGroupSnapshot GA in v1.36, CSI Changed Block Tracking Beta in v1.36, and VolumeAttributesClass GA in v1.34.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog
